# limesuite

**Host tools and library for LimeSDR hardware**

- **Version recorded:** 23.11.0
- **Categories:** `hardware`, `sdr`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/myriadrf/LimeSuite>

## What it does

LimeUtil, LimeQuickTest and the LimeSuiteGUI, plus the library the SoapySDR module is built against, for configuring and calibrating the LMS7002M transceiver.

## Why you would want it

LimeSDR hardware needs calibration in a way most SDRs do not, and these are the tools that do it. LimeUtil --find is the first diagnostic.

## Before it will work

LimeSDR hardware. The `limesdr` hardware entry carries three identifiers confirmed from Debian's own 64-limesuite.rules (the maintainer still owns none — the gap was closed from the distribution rule, 2026-08-26), so rules can be generated from the catalog.

## How it installs

- apt: `limesuite`

## Known problems

Upstream has moved to LimeSuiteNG while every target still ships the classic 23.11 release (apt-cache policy on all four targets, 2026-08-28); the two are not interchangeable and documentation written for one will not match the other. The USB and Mini boards are different hardware with different quirks.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
